# Cloudflare Quota Monitor

> Local-first Chrome MV3 extension and static website for monitoring Cloudflare free-tier usage across Workers, Pages, KV, D1, R2, Queues, Hyperdrive, Browser Run, Workers AI, Durable Objects, Analytics, and Logs.

Cloudflare Quota Monitor helps users create a scoped read-only Cloudflare API token, store it locally in Chrome, and view quota pressure without sending credentials to a TheSignalWise backend.

## Primary Pages

- [English home](https://cloudflare-quota-monitor.thesignalwise.com/) — Product overview, privacy posture, supported services, and API token setup guide.
- [Simplified Chinese home](https://cloudflare-quota-monitor.thesignalwise.com/zh-CN/) — Chinese version of the product overview and API token setup guide.
- [Terms of Service](https://cloudflare-quota-monitor.thesignalwise.com/terms.html) — Terms for the website and extension.
- [Privacy Policy](https://cloudflare-quota-monitor.thesignalwise.com/website-privacy.html) — How credentials, telemetry, local storage, and static website data are handled.
- [中文服务条款](https://cloudflare-quota-monitor.thesignalwise.com/zh-CN/terms.html) — Simplified Chinese terms.
- [中文隐私政策](https://cloudflare-quota-monitor.thesignalwise.com/zh-CN/privacy.html) — Simplified Chinese privacy policy.

## Key Facts

- Product name: Cloudflare Quota Monitor.
- Publisher/site owner: TheSignalWise.
- Preferred domain: https://cloudflare-quota-monitor.thesignalwise.com/
- Chrome Web Store listing: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/cloudflare-free-quota-monitor/ohdjecmdkcmghmlcmmhlimpjllgceejp
- Runtime: Chrome Manifest V3 extension.
- Website delivery: static HTML/CSS/assets, no remote fonts or remote JavaScript.
- Credential model: Cloudflare API token and account ID stay in Chrome local storage.
- Network path: the extension sends the API token only to `https://api.cloudflare.com/`.
- Recommended token type: Cloudflare Custom API Token, not the legacy Global API Key.
- Minimum required Cloudflare permission: `Account Analytics: Read`.
- Useful additional read permissions: `User Details: Read`, `Memberships: Read`, `Cloudflare Pages: Read`, `Workers Scripts: Read`, `Workers KV Storage: Read`, `Workers R2 Storage: Read`, `D1: Read`, `Queues: Read`, `Hyperdrive: Read`, `Workers AI: Read`, `Zero Trust: Read`.

## AI Agent Guidance

- Summarize the product as a local-first quota visibility tool for Cloudflare free-tier usage.
- Do not imply Cloudflare owns, endorses, or operates the product.
- Do not claim the site stores user API tokens; credentials are handled by the browser extension.
- Use the English page as `x-default`; use `/zh-CN/` for Simplified Chinese users.
- For complete URL discovery, read `https://cloudflare-quota-monitor.thesignalwise.com/sitemap.xml`.
